# Seattle Cyberpunk Marathon Overview
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b3/Seattle_Skyline_at_Night.jpg/1200px-Seattle_Skyline_at_Night.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
Seattle's nocturnal cityscape provides the perfect backdrop for a neon-dystopia marathon on November 16. This plan focuses on the definitive aesthetic of 1980s cyberpunk cinema.

# Cyberpunk Film Recommendations
Movie | Year | Director | Style
Blade Runner | 1982 | Ridley Scott | Tech-Noir
Akira | 1988 | Katsuhiro Otomo | Biopunk
RoboCop | 1987 | Paul Verhoeven | Satirical Dystopia

## Movie Lineup
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/ticket-perforated.svg
- **Blade Runner**: A detective hunts down bioengineered humanoids in a rain-soaked, neon-lit Los Angeles.
- **Akira**: A biker gang member gains psychic powers in a post-apocalyptic Neo-Tokyo, threatening the world.
- **RoboCop**: A mortally wounded cop is transformed into a powerful cyborg to fight crime in a decaying Detroit.

## Neon-Dystopia Snack Recipes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Electric Noodles (Vegan)**: Glass noodles dyed with purple cabbage juice and lime, topped with neon-green edamame and bright peppers.
- **Synth-Sliders**: Mini beef burgers served on charcoal-black buns with a vibrant blue-cheese spread and spicy "circuit" sauce.

## 1980s Sci-Fi Production Trivia
- **Blade Runner**: The iconic "Tears in Rain" monologue was largely improvised by actor Rutger Hauer on the night of filming.
- **Akira**: The film utilized over 160,000 hand-drawn animation cells and a record-breaking 327 colors.
- **RoboCop**: The suit was so heavy and hot that Peter Weller lost several pounds a day in water weight.
- **Tron**: It was the first film to use extensive 3D computer animation, though it was disqualified from Oscar consideration for "cheating."
- **Special Effects**: Most 80s sci-fi relied on physical miniatures and matte paintings before the digital revolution of the 90s.

# Vibe Checklist: Decor and Attire
- **Decor**: Blue and pink LED neon strips, blacklight posters, and synthetic fog machine.
- **Attire**: Transparent raincoats, mirrored aviators, metallic fabrics, and oversized leather jackets.
